name: Convex-Treelike Characterization Equivalence
statement: The two-child peripheral recursion, peripheral-expansion trees, convex-subgraph periphery, pc-minor periphery, tree-likeness of every pc-minor, and avoidance of the complete periphery-free basis define the same class.
proof: Unfolding the recursive definition gives the binary tree certificate. Convex-subgraph closure and induction show that the recursive class is exactly the class whose nontrivial convex subgraphs have a periphery. Closure under coordinate contraction upgrades this to all pc-minors. A finite descent then replaces all periphery-free pc-minors by their pc-minimal members.
